summary: 2026-27 kit (Jako, presented 18 July 2026): Rostec centre-front, СОГАЗ and Red Wings on the chest, Новиком above the number and RBPI Group below it on the back. Sleeves carry only the Alfa-Bank RPL league patch; shorts carry only the Jako logo. Checked against the club's kit-launch post on Telegram and its own match photo galleries (2nd and 4th RPL tours).
